consequence_for_the_spec: C_stat is a mask CONSUMER (assemble_ctotal_bkgsub.py:105-107 fails closed on np.array_equal against C_syst's mask). Nesting means adopting the FPS 266 mask does not DROP any cell PET reports -- but it ADDS 4 cells PET measures as zero-acceptance, whose C_stat rows would then be identically zero. That is a declaration to make, not a default.
mechanism: The 4 cells in FPS but not PET are exactly (12,0), (13,4), (13,5), (13,6) -- and the PET extraction telemetry independently reports n_cells_masked_zero_acceptance = 4, i.e. cells with truth mass but ZERO reco acceptance. The count and the mechanism agree, so the difference is explained and not merely counted.
